  "new_text": "import numpy as np

def filter_api_calls(with_result, call_only, no_call, tau_filter):
    """Filter API calls based on log-probability margins.

    Parameters
    ----------
    with_result: np.ndarray, shape (n_candidates, future_horizon), finite nonpositive log probs
    call_only: np.ndarray, same shape, finite nonpositive log probs
    no_call: np.ndarray, same shape, finite nonpositive log probs
    tau_filter: float, finite nonnegative threshold

    Returns
    -------
    keep: np.ndarray of bool, shape (n_candidates,)
    margins: np.ndarray of float, shape (n_candidates,)
    """
    # Input validation
    for name, arr in [('with_result', with_result), ('call_only', call_only), ('no_call', no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a numpy array')
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be two-dimensional')
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must not be empty')
        if not np.issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.floating):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be floating point')
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} contains nonfinite values')
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} contains positive values')
    # Shape consistency
    if not (with_result.shape == call_only.shape == no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError('Input matrices must have the same shape')
    # tau_filter validation
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError('tau_filter must not be a boolean')
    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative scalar')
    # Compute total log probability per candidate (sum over future horizon)
    log_p_with = np.sum(with_result, axis=1)
    log_p_call = np.sum(call_only, axis=1)
    log_p_no = np.sum(no_call, axis=1)
    # Margin = improvement over best alternative (no_call or call_only)
    margin = log_p_with - np.maximum(log_p_call, log_p_no)
    # Keep if margin exceeds threshold
    keep = margin > tau_filter
    return keep, margin
